scope: Triton-Ascend and AscendC operator development, testing, review, optimization, and their selected shared support skills at fixed public revisions

summary.zh: 检索 AscendC 架构、API 陷阱、优化模式和已验证的进化经验。
summary.en: Retrieve AscendC architecture, API pitfalls, optimization patterns, and proven evolution knowledge.

summary.zh: 生成并检查进化变体、性能对比、决策过程和资源消耗的 HTML 报告。
summary.en: Generate and self-check an HTML report of evolution variants, performance, decisions, and resource use.

summary.zh: 按瓶颈和算子族检索 AscendC 优化策略并检查组合兼容性。
summary.en: Retrieve AscendC optimization strategies by bottleneck and operator family and check their compatibility.

summary.zh: 维护基于证据的决策树，选择和验证 AscendC 优化实验。
summary.en: Manage an evidence-driven decision tree for selecting and validating AscendC optimization experiments.

summary.zh: 构建部署 CANN 算子仓实现，对比基线与进化版本的精度和性能。
summary.en: Build and deploy operators from CANN operator repositories and compare baseline and evolved implementations.

summary.zh: 在保留声明覆盖维度的前提下精简算子用例集。
summary.en: Reduce an operator case set while preserving its declared coverage dimensions.

summary.zh: 创建 AscendC 算子骨架、可构建文件和后续开发清单。
summary.en: Create an AscendC operator scaffold with buildable files and a development checklist.

summary.zh: 通过 DumpTensor 和分段对比定位修复 AscendC 精度问题。
summary.en: Use DumpTensor and staged comparisons to locate and repair AscendC precision failures.

summary.zh: 组织块级和 Tile 级设计，为 AscendC 转译准备 TileLang 设计表达。
summary.en: Coordinate block- and tile-level design to prepare a TileLang description for AscendC translation.

summary.zh: 记录算子开发轨迹并提炼带来源的 Runbook，供后续检索复用。
summary.en: Record an operator-development trace and extract sourced runbooks for later retrieval.

summary.zh: 将 TileLang 设计转译为 AscendC Kernel 及 Python 调用封装。
summary.en: Translate a TileLang design into an AscendC kernel and its Python invocation wrapper.

summary.zh: 注册 Python 自定义算子、补齐 Meta 行为并适配 npugraph_ex。
summary.en: Register Python custom operators, supply Meta behavior, and adapt them to npugraph_ex.

summary.zh: 构造 AISS-TilingSolver 输入、求解 Tiling 参数并解释结果。
summary.en: Prepare inputs for AISS-TilingSolver, solve tiling parameters, and interpret the result.

summary.zh: 查询 AscendC 计算、归约、搬运、Buffer、转换和通信 API 的正确用法。
summary.en: Look up correct AscendC arithmetic, reduction, data-copy, buffer, conversion, and communication API usage.

summary.zh: 为 Ascend950 DAV_3510 选择 Blaze/Tensor API 模板并实现 MatMul 系列算子。
summary.en: Select Blaze/Tensor API templates and implement MatMul-family kernels for Ascend950 DAV_3510.

summary.zh: 按固定契约将 Ascend950 Kernel 分支迁移到 Blaze/Tensor API，并配对验证。
summary.en: Migrate an Ascend950 kernel branch to Blaze/Tensor API with frozen contracts and paired validation.

summary.zh: 基于可检验假设审查 AscendC 源码或 PR 的规范和设计一致性。
summary.en: Review AscendC source or PRs for applicable rules and design consistency using testable hypotheses.

summary.zh: 诊断 AscendC 卡死、崩溃、内存和 Buffer/同步问题。
summary.en: Diagnose AscendC hangs, crashes, memory errors, and buffer or synchronization failures.

summary.zh: 完成 AscendC 算子 A2/A3 到 A5 的架构改造及精度、性能验证。
summary.en: Migrate AscendC operators from A2/A3 to A5 with architecture adaptation and precision/performance checks.

summary.zh: 选择完整的 Vector、Blaze MatMul 或 Kirin 核函数直调工程模板。
summary.en: Select a complete Vector, Blaze MatMul, or Kirin direct-invocation project template.

summary.zh: 将现有核函数直调工程转换为 ACLNN/GEIR 注册调用算子。
summary.en: Convert an existing direct-invocation kernel into an ACLNN/GEIR registered custom operator.

summary.zh: 基于标准模板编写算子需求、详设、API 文档和 README。
summary.en: Write operator requirements, detailed design, API documentation, and README files from standard templates.

summary.zh: 通过本地索引和在线来源查找 AscendC API、样例及兼容性资料。
summary.en: Find AscendC API documentation, examples, and compatibility references using local indexes and online sources.

summary.zh: 检查 NPU 设备、CANN 配置、工具链依赖和实际架构。
summary.en: Inspect NPU devices, CANN configuration, toolchain dependencies, and the detected architecture.

summary.zh: 设计调试多卡 AscendC 通算融合及其内存、同步契约。
summary.en: Design and debug multidevice AscendC communication-computation fusion and its memory/synchronization contracts.

summary.zh: 结合 Tiling 模型和 Profiling 配平卡间、核间及核内流水。
summary.en: Use tiling models and profiling to balance interdevice, intercore, and intracore pipelines.

summary.zh: 按算子族检索优化方法、参考代码和平台流水约束。
summary.en: Retrieve operator-family optimization methods, reference code, and platform-specific pipeline constraints.

summary.zh: 将数值异常收敛为可复现单算子用例，定位根因并验证修复。
summary.en: Reduce numerical failures to a reproducible operator case, locate the cause, and verify the repair.

summary.zh: 查询 DAV_3510 RegBase API 约束、实现结构和参考算子。
summary.en: Look up DAV_3510 RegBase API constraints, implementation structures, and reference operators.

summary.zh: 创建包含 Host/Kernel 代码和 UT/ST 样例的注册调用工程。
summary.en: Create a registered AscendC operator project with host/kernel code and UT/ST examples.

summary.zh: 抽取注册算子中的 Kernel 并转换为核函数直调形式。
summary.en: Extract a registered operator kernel and adapt it to direct kernel invocation.

summary.zh: 结合错误码和 plog 定位 AscendC 调用、Tiling 和运行时故障。
summary.en: Interpret AscendC runtime error codes and plog evidence to locate invocation and tiling failures.

summary.zh: 查询 AscendC SIMT 线程排布、索引、搬运、同步和调试 API。
summary.en: Look up AscendC SIMT thread layouts, indexing, data movement, synchronization, and debugging APIs.

summary.zh: 设计 SIMT 核与线程切分、内存分配、TilingKey 和 Workspace 契约。
summary.en: Design SIMT core/thread partitioning, memory allocation, tiling keys, and workspace contracts.

summary.zh: 从 ACLNN 接口规格提取约束并生成 L0/L1/L2 系统测试用例。
summary.en: Derive constraints and generate L0/L1/L2 system-test cases from ACLNN interface specifications.

summary.zh: 检查流水、核间信号和生产消费 Buffer 一致性，并提出修复。
summary.en: Audit pipeline and intercore signals and producer/consumer buffer consistency, then propose repairs.

summary.zh: 按算子族设计多核与 UB 切分、Buffer 分配和分支覆盖。
summary.en: Design multicore and UB tiling, buffer allocation, and branch coverage by operator family.

summary.zh: 生成补充 op_host、op_api、op_kernel 单测并补齐覆盖缺口。
summary.en: Generate or extend op_host, op_api, and op_kernel unit tests and close coverage gaps.

summary.zh: 提取 Tiling/Kernel 路径并生成带覆盖检查的可执行白盒用例矩阵。
summary.en: Extract tiling/kernel paths and generate executable whitebox case matrices with coverage checks.

summary.zh: 准备昇腾算子开发所需的 CANN 安装和环境配置。
summary.en: Prepare CANN installation and environment configuration for Ascend operator development.

summary.zh: 确认芯片、架构、SocVersion、特性支持与条件编译边界。
summary.en: Resolve chip, architecture, SocVersion, feature support, and conditional-compilation boundaries.

summary.zh: 选择广播、归约和收缩范式，核对资源与实现约束。
summary.en: Choose broadcast, reduction, and contraction design paradigms and their resource/implementation constraints.

summary.zh: 按语义和输入输出 dtype 选择精度判据及 Golden 构造方式。
summary.en: Choose numerical acceptance criteria and golden construction by semantics and input/output dtype.

summary.zh: 采集可比较的算子时延和硬件指标，输出逐 Kernel 瓶颈分析。
summary.en: Collect comparable operator latency and hardware metrics and report per-kernel bottlenecks.

summary.zh: 运行主机侧 CANN 精度、性能仿真并解释流水报告。
summary.en: Run host-side CANN precision/performance simulation and interpret pipeline reports.

summary.zh: 估算 Ascend950 RegBase 纯 Vector 算子的设计期时延下界。
summary.en: Estimate design-time latency bounds for Ascend950 RegBase pure-Vector operators.

summary.zh: 将已有 AscendC 算子通过自定义接口接入 PyTorch。
summary.en: Wrap an existing AscendC operator for PyTorch using registered custom-op interfaces.

summary.zh: 每轮修改一个优化点，配对验证 Triton-Ascend 正确性与时延。
summary.en: Optimize Triton-Ascend kernels one change at a time with paired correctness and latency checks.

summary.zh: 按 dtype 校准峰值，测量算子利用率并拆解逐 Kernel 时延。
summary.en: Measure operator utilization and decompose per-kernel latency with dtype-aware peak accounting.

summary.zh: 依据任务和草图生成纯 Triton-Ascend Kernel，并按验证反馈修复。
summary.en: Generate pure Triton-Ascend kernels from a task and sketch and repair them using verifier feedback.

summary.zh: 依据算子规格和历史反馈设计感知架构的算法草图。
summary.en: Design an architecture-aware algorithm sketch from an operator specification and historical feedback.

summary.zh: 检查 Triton 实现真实性、执行 Golden 比对并采集性能结果。
summary.en: Check Triton implementation authenticity, execute golden comparisons, and collect benchmark results.

summary.zh: 定位 Triton-Ascend 数值异常并验证针对性修复。
summary.en: Diagnose Triton-Ascend numerical failures and validate a targeted repair.

summary.zh: 采集仿真指令和流水证据，将瓶颈映射到优化动作。
summary.en: Collect simulator instruction/pipe evidence and map bottlenecks to optimization actions.

summary.zh: 从用户代码或需求构建独立算子任务和输入用例。
summary.en: Construct a self-contained operator task and case inputs from user code or requirements.

summary.zh: 为跨代迁移生成源架构标杆运行器和输入清单。
summary.en: Generate source-architecture reference runners and input manifests for cross-generation migration.

summary.zh: 从 AscendC 源包或可微标杆生成常规与边界输入数据。
summary.en: Generate normal and edge-case input datasets from an AscendC source package or differentiable reference.

summary.zh: 将运行发现与知识库去重并准备带来源的知识摄入。
summary.en: Deduplicate runtime findings against the knowledge base and stage sourced knowledge intake.

summary.zh: 分类源算子，输出结构化结果和相关知识建议。
summary.en: Classify source operators and emit a structured classification with relevant knowledge recommendations.

summary.zh: 以 Profiler 和墙钟两种方式评估生成的 AscendC 算子。
summary.en: Evaluate generated AscendC operators with profiler and wall-clock measurements.

summary.zh: 查找已有目标架构迁移候选，核对来源并构建测量。
summary.en: Find, provenance-stage, build, and measure existing target-architecture migration candidates.

summary.zh: 为跨代迁移或反向算子生成输出项目报告。
summary.en: Generate a project report for cross-generation migration or backward-operator generation.

summary.zh: 检查当前算子开发会话的重复流程问题并提出修正。
summary.en: Audit the current operator-development session for recurring process failures and corrective actions.

summary.zh: 从可微 PyTorch 正向标杆生成 AscendC 反向算子并上板验证。
summary.en: Generate an AscendC backward operator from a differentiable PyTorch forward reference and verify it on NPU.

summary.zh: 按明确源、目标架构迁移 AscendC 算子并对照标杆验证。
summary.en: Port AscendC operators between declared source and target architectures with reference validation.

summary.zh: 从函数式 PyTorch 生成 AscendC 工程、Host、pybind 和 Kernel 骨架。
summary.en: Generate an AscendC project, host code, pybind wrapper, and kernel scaffold from functional PyTorch.

summary.zh: 验证 AscendC 多用例数值正确性并采集性能证据。
summary.en: Evaluate multi-case AscendC numerical correctness and collect operator performance evidence.

summary.zh: 基于假设检验诊断精度、崩溃、卡死和多核不一致。
summary.en: Use a hypothesis-driven procedure to diagnose numerical errors, crashes, hangs, and multicore inconsistency.

summary.zh: 在评测前检查生成 AscendC 的结构和算法正确性。
summary.en: Review generated AscendC structure and algorithm correctness before evaluation.

summary.zh: 为 CAKE 生成流程查找 AscendC API、样例和兼容性资料。
summary.en: Find AscendC API, example, and compatibility resources for the CAKE generation pipeline.

summary.zh: 以不同策略生成隔离的 AscendC 变体，依据实测选择候选。
summary.en: Generate isolated AscendC variants with different optimization strategies and select measured winners.

summary.zh: 检视完整 Kernel 生成轨迹并记录流程和实现改进。
summary.en: Review the complete kernel-generation trace and record process and implementation improvements.

summary.zh: 结合专家规则和源码上下文诊断 AscendC 性能瓶颈。
summary.en: Diagnose AscendC profiling bottlenecks using expert rules and source context.

summary.zh: 从函数式 PyTorch 生成 easyasc DSL 初版，供 AscendC 代码生成。
summary.en: Generate an initial easyasc DSL implementation from functional PyTorch for AscendC code generation.

summary.zh: 从函数式 PyTorch 标杆生成 AscendDSL 计算和切分结构。
summary.en: Generate AscendDSL compute and tiling structures from a functional PyTorch reference.

summary.zh: 编写仿真 easyasc 算子，再生成原生 AscendC 代码。
summary.en: Author and simulate an easyasc operator before generating native AscendC code.

summary.zh: 将 easyasc 原生生成结果适配到 CAKE 算子工程布局。
summary.en: Adapt native easyasc code-generation output to the CAKE operator project layout.

summary.zh: 通过多级 Pass 将算子 DSL 降为 AscendC，并定位编译失败。
summary.en: Lower operator DSL code to AscendC through multiple passes and diagnose compilation failures.

summary.zh: 依据验证过的性能反馈调优 DSL 切分、向量化和流水结构。
summary.en: Tune DSL tiling, vectorization, and pipeline structure using verified performance feedback.

summary.zh: 从 easyasc DSL 生成构建 AscendC，并提供编译算子产物。
summary.en: Generate and build AscendC from easyasc DSL and expose the compiled operator artifact.

summary.zh: 为 easyasc 生成的 AscendC Kernel 构建 torch_npu 绑定和 ModelNew 封装。
summary.en: Generate torch_npu bindings and ModelNew wrappers for easyasc-generated AscendC kernels.

summary.zh: 将 nn.Module 标杆转为输入显式的无状态函数式 API。
summary.en: Convert an nn.Module reference to a stateless functional API with explicit inputs.

summary.zh: 通过 Git worktree 隔离算子变体并记录阶段提交和来源。
summary.en: Isolate operator variants with Git worktrees and record stage commits and provenance.

summary.zh: 生成展示算法流、UB 切分、精度和性能的算子交互面板。
summary.en: Generate an interactive operator dashboard for algorithm flow, UB tiling, precision, and performance.

summary.zh: 生成包含 Shape、dtype 和属性的结构化算子描述。
summary.en: Generate a structured operator description with shapes, dtypes, and attributes.

summary.zh: 生成保持语义的 PyTorch Golden 及可复现输入构造器。
summary.en: Generate a faithful PyTorch golden implementation and reproducible input constructors.

summary.zh: 在指定远程 NPU 后端同步、执行和测试算子工程。
summary.en: Synchronize, execute, and test an operator project on declared remote NPU backends.

summary.zh: 记录算子生成中技能的输入、耗时和结果。
summary.en: Record skill inputs, durations, and outcomes during operator generation.

summary.zh: 维护算子工作流进度、状态变化和待办任务。
summary.en: Maintain operator-workflow progress, state transitions, and unresolved tasks.

summary.zh: 组织独立 Triton 优化轮次，保留逐轮产物与评测结果。
summary.en: Coordinate independent Triton optimization rounds and retain per-round artifacts and evaluation results.

summary.zh: 维护直调工作流契约、角色定义和回归检查。
summary.en: Maintain direct-invocation workflow contracts, role definitions, and regression checks.

summary.zh: 组织直调算子的需求、环境、分工执行、验收和交付。
summary.en: Coordinate direct-invocation requirements, environment, delegated work, acceptance, and delivery.

summary.zh: 构建直调算子和 CANN Bench 包，核对实际加载的产物。
summary.en: Build direct-invocation operators and CANN Bench packages and verify loaded artifact identity.

summary.zh: 应用 CANN Bench 实现真实性、包装、接口和 AscendC 代码规范。
summary.en: Apply CANN Bench authenticity, wrapper, interface, and AscendC code-quality rules.

summary.zh: 检查选定 Python/CANN 环境并记录对应环境证据。
summary.en: Inspect selected Python/CANN environment candidates and record scoped environment evidence.

summary.zh: 查询 CANN Bench 提交、任务、精度和评分契约。
summary.en: Look up CANN Bench submission, task, numerical, and scoring contracts.

summary.zh: 从 CANN Bench 参考工程和模板创建直调代码。
summary.en: Create direct-invocation code from the CANN Bench reference project and operator templates.

summary.zh: 记录跨重试复用的算子需求、环境选择和修改范围。
summary.en: Record confirmed operator requirements, environment choices, and modification scope across retries.

summary.zh: 组织 proto、Golden、用例资产，以 CANN Bench 执行黑盒、白盒和回归评测。
summary.en: Create proto/golden/cases assets and run blackbox, whitebox, and regression evaluation with CANN Bench.

summary.zh: 检查修复 AscendC Host/Kernel 构建及代码生成链路。
summary.en: Inspect and repair the AscendC host/kernel build and code-generation pipeline.

summary.zh: 针对已部署候选全量执行 TTK ACLNN 黑盒套件并核对结果数量。
summary.en: Run full TTK ACLNN blackbox suites against the deployed candidate and validate result counts.

summary.zh: 将已核对算子事实填入指定 ACLNN 设计模板。
summary.en: Render a selected ACLNN design template with the caller's verified operator facts.

summary.zh: 启动 ACLNN 注册调用算子开发工作流。
summary.en: Start the ACLNN registered-operator development workflow.

summary.zh: 调研模型场景、参考框架和 CANN 能力，编写算子需求。
summary.en: Research model usage, reference frameworks, and CANN capabilities to write operator requirements.

summary.zh: 独立检查 ST 覆盖、设计一致性、框架集成和执行证据。
summary.en: Independently check ST coverage, design consistency, framework integration, and execution evidence.

summary.zh: 为 Tiling UT 设计带明确失败或降级断言的负向用例。
summary.en: Design negative Tiling UTs with explicit failure/degradation assertions.

summary.zh: 使用指定平台 Mock 和已安装 Host 库构建运行 TilingFunc gtest。
summary.en: Build and run host-side TilingFunc gtests with the declared platform mocks and installed host library.

summary.zh: 检测目标架构并选择对应注册算子工作流。
summary.en: Detect the target architecture and select the matching registered-operator workflow.

summary.zh: 检索匹配平台的 AscendC API 知识卡并追溯源码和头文件。
summary.en: Retrieve platform-matched AscendC API cards and follow verified source/header references.

summary.zh: 将登记文档或固定版本源码转为受治理、可追溯的候选知识。
summary.en: Convert registered documents or fixed source revisions into governed, traceable knowledge candidates.

summary.zh: 校验知识结构、来源、导航和生命周期元数据。
summary.en: Validate knowledge structure, provenance, navigation, and lifecycle metadata.

summary.zh: 在算子设计、实现、测试和优化决策前检索匹配平台的知识卡。
summary.en: Retrieve platform-aware knowledge cards before operator design, implementation, testing, or optimization decisions.

summary.zh: 提取完整 Cube/MIX_CV 算子路径及数据流、资源和同步契约。
summary.en: Extract complete Cube/MIX_CV operator paths and their dataflow, resource, and synchronization contracts.

summary.zh: 将算子开发轨迹提炼为带来源的诊断 Runbook 和修复模式。
summary.en: Distill operator-development traces into sourced diagnostic runbooks and reusable repair patterns.

summary.zh: 提取非 Cube 算子路径及内存、Workspace、同步和生命周期契约。
summary.en: Extract non-Cube operator routes and their memory, workspace, synchronization, and lifecycle contracts.

summary.zh: 依据设计文档实现 AscendC API 并验证代码变更。
summary.en: Implement AscendC APIs from a supplied design document and verify repository changes.

summary.zh: 生成 AscendC API 单测并依据覆盖率报告补齐用例。
summary.en: Generate AscendC API unit tests and use coverage reports to fill missing cases.

summary.zh: 将需求文档转为结构化测试用例文档。
summary.en: Turn a supplied requirement document into a structured test-case document.

summary.zh: 分析 AscendC 需求、实现评审 Host/Device 代码并规划验证。
summary.en: Analyze AscendC requirements, implement/review host-device code, and plan validation.

summary.zh: 结合源码和 API 约束编写 AscendC 详设及测试计划。
summary.en: Write detailed AscendC design and test plans grounded in source and API constraints.

summary.zh: 检查 CMake 生成文件依赖缺口和并行构建竞态。
summary.en: Find generated-file dependency gaps and parallel build races in CMake projects.

summary.zh: 审查 Ascend DevKit PR 并形成基于源码的检视意见。
summary.en: Review Ascend DevKit pull requests and produce source-grounded findings.

summary.zh: 按精确版本检查 GitCode PR 和跨仓契约，并进行反证检验。
summary.en: Review exact GitCode PR revisions and cross-repository contracts with counterexample checks.

summary.zh: 规划 AscendC 语义、精度、Tiling、Buffer 和流水实现方案。
summary.en: Plan AscendC semantics, numerical requirements, tiling, buffering, and pipeline implementation.

summary.zh: 从设计中的测试章节生成可执行 AscendC 验证资产。
summary.en: Generate executable AscendC validation assets from the testing section of a supplied design.

summary.zh: 通过内存 Dump 复现 GM/UB 搬运对齐及字节重解释问题。
summary.en: Reproduce GM/UB copy alignment and byte-reinterpretation failures using memory dumps.

summary.zh: 通过仓内远程执行器运行独立测试并回收结构化证据。
summary.en: Run standalone tests through the repository remote runner and collect structured execution evidence.

summary.zh: 澄清 SIMT 需求并编写实现与验收规格。
summary.en: Clarify a SIMT requirement and draft its implementation and acceptance specification.

summary.zh: 依据已确认需求创建 SIMT 测试用例和缺陷记录模板。
summary.en: Create a SIMT test-case and defect-record template from a confirmed requirement.

summary.zh: 复现 UB 边界、向量读写、Mask 和搬运内存问题。
summary.en: Reproduce UB boundary, vector-load/store, mask, and data-copy memory failures.

summary.zh: 以 optest 计划描述 AscendC 用例，执行数据生成、调用与校验。
summary.en: Describe AscendC cases in an optest plan and execute data generation, invocation, and validation.

summary.en: Design an algorithm sketch and execution strategy for a Triton-Ascend task.

summary.zh: 结合任务、草图、架构和验证反馈生成 Triton-Ascend 代码。
summary.en: Generate Triton-Ascend code from a task, sketch, architecture, and previous verification feedback.

summary.zh: 按中间数据和执行契约将算子拆分为合适的 Triton Kernel。
summary.en: Split an operator into suitable Triton kernels with intermediate-data and execution contracts.

summary.zh: 检查 Triton 实现结构、执行 Golden 比对并测量通过候选。
summary.en: Check Triton implementation structure, run golden comparisons, and benchmark valid candidates.

summary.zh: 依据测量反馈迭代优化 Triton-Ascend 时延，并回归精度。
summary.en: Iteratively optimize Triton-Ascend latency with measured feedback and numerical regression checks.

summary.zh: 从需求或源码提取独立可评测的算子任务。
summary.en: Extract a self-contained operator benchmark task from user requirements or source.

summary.zh: 按分发和算子契约实现测试昇腾 PyTorch op-plugin 绑定。
summary.en: Implement and test Ascend PyTorch op-plugin bindings with matched dispatch and operator contracts.

summary.zh: 在 ascend-kernel 工程中组织设计、生成、构建、精度评估、采集与优化。
summary.en: Coordinate design, generation, build, numerical evaluation, profiling, and optimization in an ascend-kernel project.

summary.zh: 检查已有 NPU 环境，按明确 Shape 和计时条件评测算子。
summary.en: Check an existing NPU environment and benchmark an operator with declared shapes and timing conditions.

summary.zh: 将 GPU Triton 或 PyTorch 语义迁移到 Triton-Ascend，生成最小上板验证脚本。
summary.en: Port GPU Triton or PyTorch semantics to Triton-Ascend and produce a minimal device validation script.

summary.zh: 开发使用 MindIE-SD 微基准，对比真实算子实现并检测性能漂移。
summary.en: Develop and use MindIE-SD microbenchmarks to compare real operator implementations and detect drift.

summary.zh: 路由到 CANNBot 算子技能，并叠加 MindIE-SD 集成、部署和模型验证约束。
summary.en: Route operator work to CANNBot and apply MindIE-SD integration, deployment, and model-validation constraints.

summary.zh: 分析 AscendC 需求、核对 API、实现评审代码并规划构建、仿真与上板验证。
summary.en: Analyze AscendC requirements, verify API facts, implement/review code, and plan build/simulation/device validation.

summary.zh: 依据结构化架构约束生成 DevKit API gtest，并按覆盖率补齐用例。
summary.en: Generate DevKit API gtests with structured architecture constraints and coverage-driven case backfill.

summary.zh: 确认 DevKit 芯片名、架构宏、SocVersion、dtype 和 API 支持事实。
summary.en: Resolve DevKit chip names, architecture macros, SocVersion, dtype, and API support facts.

summary.zh: 建立查询 AscendC C API 文档索引，按需求定位资料。
summary.en: Build and query an index of AscendC C API documentation for requirement-driven lookup.

summary.zh: 协调 Triton 算子开发、正确性验证与性能优化，衔接各阶段证据。
summary.en: Coordinate complete Ascend Triton operator development, correctness validation and optimization with linked evidence.

summary.zh: 从 PyTorch 参考或 GPU Triton 实现开发首个 Ascend Triton 算子候选。
summary.en: Develop the first correct Ascend Triton kernel from a PyTorch reference or a GPU Triton implementation.

summary.zh: 按 shape、dtype、layout 和 stride 矩阵验证候选与参考，检查执行路径和 fallback。
summary.en: Validate an Ascend Triton candidate against a trusted reference with a declared case matrix and fallback gate.

summary.zh: 对正确性通过的内核进行逐 shape 测量，结合 profiler 迭代优化。
summary.en: Optimize a correctness-passed Ascend Triton kernel with per-shape measurements and profiler evidence.

summary.zh: 将模型异常缩小到单算子调用，检查 dtype、shape、layout 与执行模式。
summary.en: Reduce an Ascend model symptom to one operator call and validate its dtype, shape, layout and execution modes.

summary.zh: 分析 rank、step、layer、block、算子及跨 rank 行为，输出可追溯的瓶颈证据。
summary.en: Analyze Ascend profiler roots into rank, step, layer, block, operator and cross-rank findings with traceable evidence.
